note: Submodule of visitors. Adds geolocation (country/region/city) to the analytics by resolving logged IPs against a MaxMind GeoLite2 City database (geoip2/geoip2 library). Config object visitors_geoip.settings has geoip_path (path to the .mmdb) and license (MaxMind license key). Settings form route visitors_geoip.settings at /admin/config/system/visitors/geoip; rebuild form at /admin/config/system/visitors/rebuild-location. Service visitors_geoip.lookup (GeoIpService: city($ip), metadata(), hasLibrary(), hasExtension()). Report routes /visitors/location/region/{country}/{region} and /visitors/location/city/{country}/{region}/{city} (perm access visitors, from parent). Drush: visitors:download:city (download DB) and visitors:rebuild:location (recompute geo). No permissions of its own. Medium/hard cases are grounded in the local visitors_geoip.settings config and the live geoip2 library availability; no MaxMind download or external call is needed.

evals.prompt: What does the visitors_geoip submodule add, where is it configured, and what two settings does its config object hold?
evals.expected_output: It adds country/region/city geolocation reports to Visitors using a MaxMind GeoLite2 database. It is configured at /admin/config/system/visitors/geoip (route visitors_geoip.settings), and its config object visitors_geoip.settings holds geoip_path (the .mmdb database location) and license (MaxMind license key).

evals.prompt: Which Drush commands does visitors_geoip provide to download the MaxMind database and to populate location data for already-logged visits?
evals.expected_output: visitors:download:city (alias visitors-download-city) downloads/updates the GeoLite2 City database using the configured license key; visitors:rebuild:location (alias visitors-rebuild-location) recomputes country/region/city from the IP addresses already in the visitors log.

evals.prompt: What new report URLs does visitors_geoip add to the Visitors analytics, and what permission controls access to them?
evals.expected_output: It adds /visitors/location/region/{country}/{region} and /visitors/location/city/{country}/{region}/{city} report routes (ReportController), gated by the parent module's 'access visitors' permission.

evals.prompt: On this site, visitors_geoip has been told where its MaxMind database lives. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the geoip database path it is configured with.

Does this site have the MaxMind geoip2 PHP library that visitors_geoip needs to resolve IPs to locations? Inspect the running site (the visitors_geoip lookup service) and report whether the library is available.
evals.expected_output: Yes: the geoip2 library is available. The visitors_geoip.lookup service (GeoIpService) hasLibrary() returns TRUE (the GeoIp2\Database\Reader class is present, pulled in by geoip2/geoip2).

evals.prompt: Configure visitors_geoip so it looks for its MaxMind GeoIP database in the directory /var/lib/vgeoip/. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: visitors_geoip.settings:geoip_path == '/var/lib/vgeoip/' (set on the GeoIP settings form at /admin/config/system/visitors/geoip, or `drush config:set visitors_geoip.settings geoip_path '/var/lib/vgeoip/'`).

evals.prompt: Set the MaxMind license key for visitors_geoip to the value 'VGEOIP_TEST_KEY' so it can download the GeoLite2 database. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: visitors_geoip.settings:license == 'VGEOIP_TEST_KEY' (set on the GeoIP settings form, or `drush config:set visitors_geoip.settings license 'VGEOIP_TEST_KEY'`).
